Moss's notes mention two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at doors 14–18 of the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their bay assignments by text. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the 04:00 shift on 5 Oct got through the gate with no manual help.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was then escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. This note has no date, so I can't tell when the ticket was opened.

Before you add these to the weekly notes:
- They're written differently ("PD-4492" and "4419") and are about different problems, so treat them as two separate tickets.
- I checked every Moss file I could open, all six (four North, two Central). The Central ones mention tickets #4409 and #4412, but those belong to Marrow Fieldworks, not QFL.
- I left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways." That's a different company, not one of our customers, and it isn't one of Moss's notes.
- Moss hasn't posted in any channel you're in, and the #inc-qfl-sev1 incident on 4 Nov 2025 had no ticket number in the channel.
